title: Ch. Little Thunder Of Big-Foot de Thalek

parts: CH. Little Thunder Of Big-Foot de Thalek
Male, born on July 7, 2000. HD: A-A. Shoulder height: 62 cm. ACABE Sociability test: PASSED.
Parents DNA-identified at the Faculty of Veterinary Medicine in León.
From the cross of our female Wanda and Multi Ch. Impact Performance, a male from Brinkley lines and very old lines such as Pockethall.

He has a great neck, an excellent head and outstanding front and rear angulation, creating an impressive outline complemented by good bone, dark brown eyes and good pigmentation. His hocks are short and well let down. His coat is extraordinarily dense and abundant, with an excellent texture. An exceptionally well-proportioned dog.

Thunder achieved Excellent 3 on his first appearance in the ring at the International Dog Show of Oporto 2003. On his second appearance, in Torrelavega 2003, he achieved Excellent 1 CAC, CACIB, BOS. His campaign so far has been excellent, beating at one of his shows the male who won the CAC at the European Bobtail Specialty held in Barcelona in 2003, which we unfortunately could not attend because we were caring for a litter of newborn puppies. At one of his latest appearances, he achieved Excellent 1 CAC-QC, CACIB and Best of Breed under the specialist judge Barbara Müller, thus earning the obligatory point for the Portuguese championship. He also achieved Excellent 3 at the 2004 Bobtail Specialty under the specialist judge Jan Betts.
He displays his mother's bearing and elegance of movement, her great intelligence and her ability to learn.
He is the father of our litters C, E, F and G.
